class.name: VideoStreamWebm
class.description: [VideoStream] resource handling the [url=https://www.webmproject.org/]WebM[/url] video format with [code].webm[/code] extension. WebM is currently decoded on the CPU, but decoding its video may be hardware-accelerated in the future. The supported video codec is VP9, and the supported audio codecs are Opus and Vorbis. WebM is more efficient than [VideoStreamTheora], but is more intensive to decode on the CPU. [b]Note:[/b] The VP8, AV1 and AV2 video codecs are not supported, and will result in a blank video. [b]Note:[/b] Unlike [VideoStreamTheora], an alpha channel (also known as transparency) is supported. This means WebM videos may contain transparent areas. [b]Runtime loading:[/b] [code].webm[/code] files are not imported. [method ResourceLoader.load] returns a [VideoStreamWebm] for any [code].webm[/code] path, also outside the project (for example in [code]user://[/code], in a mod folder, at an absolute path or in a PCK), with the resource cache, [method ResourceLoader.load_threaded_request] and [method ResourceLoader.exists]. Any base class works as type hint ([VideoStream], [Resource]). The resource only stores the path in [member VideoStream.file]: each playback opens the file and streams it, so the video is never held in memory as a whole, and the file must stay in place while it plays. Loading checks only that the file starts with an EBML header (otherwise it fails with [constant ERR_FILE_UNRECOGNIZED]); the codec headers are read when playback starts. If an editor import plugin imports [code].webm[/code] files (a [code].import[/code] file next to the video), those files are loaded through their importer, unless the import mode is "Keep File" or "Skip File". [b]Note:[/b] [method ResourceSaver.save] cannot write [code].webm[/code] files, because the engine has no WebM encoder. [codeblocks] [gdscript] var video = ResourceLoader.load("user://videos/intro.webm") as VideoStreamWebm $VideoStreamPlayer.stream = video $VideoStreamPlayer.play() [/gdscript] [csharp] var video = ResourceLoader.Load<VideoStreamWebm>("user://videos/intro.webm"); GetNode<VideoStreamPlayer>("VideoStreamPlayer").Stream = video; GetNode<VideoStreamPlayer>("VideoStreamPlayer").Play(); [/csharp] [/codeblocks]
